products.name: IWB/OWB Revolver Holster, No Cutting, Metal Belt Clip, Ambidextrous Draw | Discreet concealed carry, durable polymer build, secure retention, wide compatibility
specs:
Wide Compatibility for Standard Sizes Designed to fit a broad range of standard handheld device dimensions, from small compact models to larger full-size frames. The flexible construction adapts to different shapes and sizes, providing a consistent fit for most common 9mm, .380, and .45ACP caliber devices available on the market.

Important Note: This product is not compatible with devices that have additional attachments such as laser sights or flashlights.

Durable Water-Resistant Material Constructed from 1000D nylon material that offers water resistance and long-lasting performance during regular use. Reinforced stitching throughout provides structural integrity, while zinc-iron alloy snaps and TPU elastic straps work together to keep your device securely positioned.

Reversible Belt Clip Design Can be used on either the right or left side. Simply move the steel belt clip to the desired side to match your preferred carrying style. The metal clip fits securely on belts up to 2 inches wide, providing stable attachment during daily activities.

Secure Retention with Easy Access Equipped with an elastic thumb break strap that helps prevent accidental dislodgement while still allowing for smooth and quick access when needed. The simple design is easy to use for all users.

No Modifications Required This product arrives fully assembled and ready to use immediately upon opening. The integrated elastic system adjusts automatically to different device sizes. Simply insert your device, adjust the strap tension to your preference, and you are ready to go.
